name: Scrape web pages to LLM-ready Markdown with the Firecrawl node and Ragfeed

parameters.content:
## Scrape web pages to LLM-ready Markdown with the Firecrawl node and Ragfeed

### Who it's for
n8n users who use the Firecrawl node and want a Firecrawl-compatible API hosted in Germany, or the compact `llmMarkdown` format for LLM steps.

### How it works
1. **Set URL Field** holds the page to scrape.
2. **Scrape page with Ragfeed** is the official Firecrawl node with a Ragfeed credential. A custom body asks for `llmMarkdown`: the main content, cleaned for language models, with title, URL and fetch time in a short header.
3. **Format Text for LLM Input** keeps title and text, ready for an OpenAI, Anthropic or Mistral node.

### Setup steps
1. Install the Firecrawl community node (*Settings > Community Nodes*, package `@mendable/n8n-nodes-firecrawl`). On n8n Cloud it is already available.
2. In **Scrape page with Ragfeed**, create a credential **Firecrawl API**. On n8n Cloud the node preselects **Gateway credits**, which calls Firecrawl itself: pick **Create new credential** instead.
   - **Base URL:** `https://api.ragfeed.de/v2`
   - **API Key:** your Ragfeed key (`sk-...`)
3. Put your page into **Set URL Field** and run the workflow.

### Requirements
A Ragfeed API key. Free plan: 1,000 credits a month, 1 credit per page. Sign-up and dashboard are in German: https://ragfeed.de/en

### Customization
Swap `llmMarkdown` for `markdown` to get the standard Firecrawl format. Existing Firecrawl workflows switch to Ragfeed by changing only the credential.

## Set scrape target

Starts the workflow manually and defines the page URL that is sent to Ragfeed.

## Scrape and prepare text

The Firecrawl node calls Ragfeed with a custom body, because the node does not list `llmMarkdown`. The last node keeps title and text. Connect your AI node after it.
